name: Finasteride
description: Synthetic 4-azasteroid that blocks type II 5α-reductase, taken by mouth

items.label: Topical spray
items.detail: One Phase III; not US approved

note.text: A 12-month trial in 137 postmenopausal women showed no improvement over placebo. No topical form is FDA approved.

bullets: **Competitive inhibitor** of type II 5α-reductase, per the label
**About 100-fold selective** for type II over type I, in lab binding studies
**Blood DHT** fell about 65% within 24 hours of a 1 mg tablet
**Testosterone** rose about 15%, staying in the normal range

practical.halfLife: About 5 to 6 hours (men 18 to 60); 8 hours over 70
practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak in 1 to 2 hours; liver metabolism (CYP3A4)

regulatory.text: Patient card on psychiatric, sexual effects

references: Kaufman et al., J Am Acad Dermatol, finasteride in male pattern hair loss, Oct 1998
